set_static_ip: awk -v i={interface} '$0 == "# freedomnas begin " i {{s = 1}} !s {{print}} $0 == "# freedomnas end " i {{s = 0}}' /etc/dhcpcd.conf > /etc/dhcpcd.conf.new

printf '# freedomnas begin %s
interface %s
static ip_address=%s/%s
static routers=%s
static domain_name_servers=%s
# freedomnas end %s
' {interface} {interface} {ip} {cidr} {gateway} {dns} {interface} >> /etc/dhcpcd.conf.new
set_dynamic_ip: awk -v i={interface} '$0 == "# freedomnas begin " i {{s = 1}} !s {{print}} $0 == "# freedomnas end " i {{s = 0}}' /etc/dhcpcd.conf > /etc/dhcpcd.conf.new
